name: Spanish Minor
description: A minimum grade of C (2.0) in SPAN 301 is required as a prerequisite for any concentration in Spanish. Programs for students wishing to major or minor in Spanish are worked out individually with an appropriate departmental advisor. Note: Given the range of study-abroad options and opportunities to earn Core through Spanish courses, early advising is strongly encouraged, especially for students with tight schedules.

courses.title: Advanced Grammar, Composition and Conversation I
Advanced Grammar, Composition and Conversation II
Introduction to the Hispanic World I
Introduction to the Hispanic World II

notes.text: an advisor-approved Spanish semester or summer course abroad, to provide sufficient Spanish electives to reach 20 hours for the program
